rationale.en: The FPPC list shows Building a Better California, whose top donors it lists as Sergey Brin and L. John Doerr III, gave $89,800,000 to the Proposition 42 committee and $58,350,000 to the Proposition 41 committee. Cal-Access itemized filings for Building a Better California list seven contributions from Sergey Brin between January 12 and July 24, 2026, totaling $102,000,000, more than the $57 million the argument cites. The filings do not trace his money measure by measure. "Sham" is a characterization, not a checkable fact.
